# Making business model decisions like scientists: Strategic commitment, uncertainty, and economic performance

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Bingham, Connelly & Dean  
**Year:** 2025  
**Journal:** Strategic Management Journal  
**DOI:** [10.1002/smj.3636](https://doi.org/10.1002/smj.3636)

**Keywords:** business model, decision-making, scientific approach, entrepreneurship, uncertainty

## Abstract

A field experiment with 261 entrepreneurs examining how a scientific approach to business model decision-making affects performance under uncertainty.
